text: If there is much art in speaking to the purpose, there is no less in knowing when to be silent. There is an eloquent silence which serves to approve or to condemn, there is a silence of discretion and of respect.
author: Francois de La Rochefoucauld
reference: Reflections; or Sentences and Moral Maxims
translation: J. W. Willis Bund and J. Hain Friswell, 1871
